title: ML Platform Engineer
text:
Quanta Retail's ML Platform team builds the tools our 60 data scientists use to train and serve models.

What you'll do
- Build the training and model serving platform on Kubernetes with Kubeflow and Ray-free batch jobs on Spark.
- Maintain the feature store and model registry (MLflow); add CI/CD for models.
- Serve PyTorch and XGBoost models with low latency (ONNX, CUDA where it pays off).
- Write platform services in Python and Go with gRPC APIs.
- Instrument everything with OpenTelemetry and Grafana dashboards.
- Partner on MLOps best practices: reproducibility, monitoring and data quality.

Requirements
- 4+ years of software engineering, 2+ on ML infrastructure.
- Experience with AWS or GCP, Docker, Terraform.
- Understanding of machine learning and deep learning workflows.
- BS/MS in Computer Science or similar.
